text: SymPO: Consistency by Construction via Permutation Symmetry for Preference Optimization will be presented at the MRAC Workshop of ACM Multimedia 2026 in Rio de Janeiro (Nov 10–14).
text_zh: SymPO: Consistency by Construction via Permutation Symmetry for Preference Optimization 將於 ACM Multimedia 2026 的 MRAC Workshop 發表（里約熱內盧，11 月 10–14 日）。

text: 2nd place in the MER 2026 Emotion Preference Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026: Meng-Ching Chen, Xin-You Song and Sheng-Bi Chen.
text_zh: ACM Multimedia 2026 MER 2026 情緒偏好挑戰賽第二名：Meng-Ching Chen、Xin-You Song、Sheng-Bi Chen。

text: AI CUP 2026 table-tennis tactics and outcome prediction challenge: honorable mention for Meng-Ching Chen, Xin-You Song and Chih-Kai Ku.
text_zh: AI CUP 2026 桌球戰術與勝負預測競賽：Meng-Ching Chen、Xin-You Song、Chih-Kai Ku 獲佳作。

text: EmoRecog-Net: A Multimodal Framework for Emotion Recognition From fMRI and Physiological Signals is published in IEEE Access.
text_zh: EmoRecog-Net: A Multimodal Framework for Emotion Recognition From fMRI and Physiological Signals 刊登於 IEEE Access。

text: Best Oral at SPRA 2026 (Osaka) for Multi-Scale Feature Learning with Swin Transformer and Hybrid Task Cascade for Robust H&E Cell Analysis: Hsiang-Chin Chien and Ching-Ping Wang.
text_zh: SPRA 2026（大阪）最佳口頭報告：Multi-Scale Feature Learning with Swin Transformer and Hybrid Task Cascade for Robust H&E Cell Analysis，Hsiang-Chin Chien、Ching-Ping Wang。

text: Three awards at SEMBA 2026 (Taipei): Excellent oral paper awards for Vessel-BloomSeg (Hsu-Cheng Wu et al.) and CTS-ContextNet (You-Chen Li et al.), and the Best poster award for A Two-Stage Neonatal Model with Multiple Brain Regions (Xin-Di Ma and Sheng-Bi Chen).
text_zh: SEMBA 2026（台北）三項獎項：Vessel-BloomSeg（Hsu-Cheng Wu 等）與 CTS-ContextNet（You-Chen Li 等）獲優秀口頭論文獎；A Two-Stage Neonatal Model with Multiple Brain Regions（Xin-Di Ma、Sheng-Bi Chen）獲最佳海報獎。

text: AI CUP 2025 cardiac muscle CT segmentation challenge: Yu-Hao Liu, Xin-You Song and You-Chen Li finish in the top tier.
text_zh: AI CUP 2025 心肌 CT 分割競賽：Yu-Hao Liu、Xin-You Song、You-Chen Li 名列前段。

text: Attention-Driven Semantic Segmentation of Liver Parenchyma in Ultrasound Imaging is presented at IEEE AVSS 2025 (Tainan).
text_zh: Attention-Driven Semantic Segmentation of Liver Parenchyma in Ultrasound Imaging 於 IEEE AVSS 2025（台南）發表。

text: 8th place in the Taiwan Future Accident Classification Challenge at IEEE AVSS 2025: Yu-Hao Liu, Xin-You Song, Chun-Chia Ku, Chih-Kai Ku and You-Chen Li.
text_zh: IEEE AVSS 2025 Taiwan Future Accident Classification Challenge 第 8 名：Yu-Hao Liu、Xin-You Song、Chun-Chia Ku、Chih-Kai Ku、You-Chen Li。

text: AI CUP 2025 medical speech de-identification challenge: honorable mention for Yu-Hao Liu, Xin-You Song and Chun-Chia Ku with their teammates.
text_zh: AI CUP 2025 醫療語音去識別化競賽：Yu-Hao Liu、Xin-You Song、Chun-Chia Ku 與隊友獲佳作。

text: Boosting predictive accuracy in tumor cellularity evaluation with AI-powered ensemble methods is published in Health and Technology.
text_zh: Boosting predictive accuracy in tumor cellularity evaluation with AI-powered ensemble methods 刊登於 Health and Technology。

text: Four papers presented at ICBHI 2024 (Tainan) on emotion recognition from fMRI and physiological signals.
text_zh: 四篇關於 fMRI 與生理訊號情緒辨識的論文於 ICBHI 2024（台南）發表。

text: Gold medal at AI CUP 2024 cross-camera multi-target vehicle tracking challenge (parameter track): Chun-Chia Ku and Chih-Kai Ku with their teammates.
text_zh: AI CUP 2024 跨攝影機多目標車輛追蹤競賽（參數組）金牌：Chun-Chia Ku、Chih-Kai Ku 與隊友。
